title: Screen out the batches that can be shipped
goal: uses filter to retain the original items of the array according to conditions, and correctly handles values ​​that happen to reach the threshold.
summary: The warehouse selects batches that can be shipped based on the quantity of each batch of items. Lots that meet the minimum quantity should be retained.
tasks: complete selectReadyBatches(counts, minimum). counts stores the quantity of each batch, and minimum is the minimum quantity allowed to be shipped.
Returns the original value with a quantity greater than or equal to minimum, preserving order and duplicates. If no items meet the criteria, an empty array is returned.

example.note: filter judges conditions on array items, and items with a true result appear in the result in the original order.

hint: batches that are exactly equal to minimum can also be shipped. Use >= to determine whether this boundary value can be included.
